notes: Every installation and delivery article's PHOTOGRAPHS, one or two frames each, for the nationwide delivery beat. THE FIRST TILE IS FIXED: it is the frame the beat already led with and Jarich asked to keep it at the start. Places only, never names. ☠️ PHOTOGRAPHS ONLY. Nine tiles were removed on 2026-09-06 because they were advertising, not evidence: the five p### files are designed cards (two proof of delivery panels with a QR code and an ORDER NOW button, two monthly price cards, one thank you card), the two install-2026 files are marketing collateral (a studio render still captioned Step 4, and a How We Install promo graphic), one v frame is overprinted with a Bound to Pangasinan title, and one is a screenshot of a map. The naming holds the rule: p### means a poster the design desk made, v### means a frame from real footage. Anything added later that carries overlaid selling text, a price, a render or a screenshot does not belong on this strip. EXTENDABLE: the strip reads any number of entries and re-times itself.
